name: בֶּן־חָנָן
gloss: son of the gracious one; or son of Hanan
summary: בֵּן “son” with חָנָן. A son of Shimon in the line of Judah (1Ch 4:20).

evidence.note: “The sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, בֶּן־חָנָן, and Tilon.”

note: Takes b.ca.al (1 token), BDB's key under בן; the database also files the חָנָן here under h.dz.ag by spelling. Whether חָנָן is the adjective “gracious” or the name Hanan is not decided.
